user.title: Proof account
user.description: Sign in with your Proof app account. You must use the phone number you log in to the mobile app with — email addresses are not accepted. A verification code will be sent to that number by SMS.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Enter the code that was just sent by SMS to {username}.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Proof
reauth_confirm.description: The Proof session for {username} has expired — the cloud allows one login per account, so this happens when you sign in on the phone or after a few days. Press Submit to text a fresh code; your password is remembered.

rtsp.title: RTSP for an NVR
rtsp.description: Offer the dashcam to an NVR (HiLook/Hikvision, Frigate, Blue Iris, Synology…) as an RTSP stream. Live video uses the dashcam's mobile data. Triggers, port and login can be changed later under Configure → RTSP / NVR.

data_description.rtsp_mode: Off: no RTSP server. Only when triggered: live video while an alert, a drive, the RTSP live switch or an automation calls for it, and a still standby picture the rest of the time, so the NVR stays connected. Always: live video whenever the NVR is connected — it streams over the dashcam's mobile data for as long as the NVR records, and keeps the dashcam awake while parked.

error.invalid_code: That verification code was rejected. Note that only the newest code is valid — if you requested more than one, use the most recent SMS, or start again to get a new code.
error.invalid_auth: The password was rejected by the Proof cloud. Check it and a new code will be sent.
error.invalid_phone: The Proof cloud does not recognise this phone number. Use the number you sign in to the mobile app with.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Proof cloud

abort.already_configured: This Proof account is already configured

data.enable_media_browser: Browse recorded event clips in Media
data.enable_live: Live view camera (streams over the dashcam's cellular data)
data.live_keepalive: Live view: keep streaming for (seconds after you stop watching)
data.settings_interval: Re-read camera settings every (hours, 0 = only when asked)
data.album_limit: Recordings to show per album folder
data.selfcheck_interval: Run self-check every (hours, 0 = only when asked)
data.event_images: Recent event snapshots to show as a grid

data_description.enable_snapshot: Adds an image entity showing the most recent impact snapshot. Downloaded only when viewed.
data_description.enable_media_browser: Lists recorded impact and collision clips under Media. Nothing is downloaded until you open a clip.
data_description.enable_live: Adds a live camera. The dashcam only streams while you are watching, using its own mobile data.
data_description.live_keepalive: How long to keep the live stream running after you stop watching. Set 0 to keep it running until you close it (uses cellular data continuously).
data_description.settings_interval: Reading the camera settings connects to the dashcam and uses a little of its mobile data. Leave at 0 to only read them when you press Refresh settings; the last values are remembered between restarts either way.
data_description.album_limit: How many of the newest recordings each album folder lists. Nothing is downloaded — a recording is only fetched from the cloud when you open it — so this just keeps the lists short.
data_description.selfcheck_interval: Checks the SIM, signal, server connection, ignition and GPS from what the dashcam last reported. Costs nothing — it uses data already polled.
data_description.event_images: Creates that many image entities holding the newest event snapshots, newest first, so a dashboard can show them as small pictures you tap for the full picture and its details. 0 turns them off.
data_description.snapshot_interval: How often the camera snapshots refresh while the auto-refresh switch is on. Each refresh wakes the dashcam and uses its mobile data.
data_description.message_images: Some alerts (anti-theft, vibration, collision) leave a photo from each camera. This is how many of those photos to keep as entities. 0 turns them off.

rtsp.description:
Give the NVR these addresses (one per camera):
{urls}

data.rtsp_driving_grace: Keep live after the ignition goes off (minutes)

data_description.rtsp_mode: Off: no RTSP server. Only when triggered: live video while an alert, a drive, the RTSP live switch or an automation calls for it, and a still standby picture the rest of the time, so the NVR stays connected. Always: live video whenever the NVR is connected — it streams over the dashcam's mobile data for as long as the NVR records, and keeps the dashcam awake while parked.
data_description.rtsp_camera: The dashcam streams one camera at a time. 'Both' gives each camera its own address (an NVR channel each); while live they take turns, and each shows its last picture between turns. A camera you open in Home Assistant keeps the dashcam while you watch.
data_description.rtsp_alerts: Only in the 'only when triggered' mode. Ignition is the separate while-driving trigger below.
data_description.rtsp_alert_minutes: Another alert in that time extends it.
data_description.rtsp_driving: From ignition on until it goes off, plus the time below.
data_description.rtsp_port: The NVR connects to this port on Home Assistant. Changing it restarts the stream.
data_description.rtsp_username: Leave both empty for no login. If set, the NVR needs them too.
data_description.rtsp_alternate_seconds: How long each camera stays live before the other takes over. Each switch costs about a second without video.

error.rtsp_credentials: Enter both a user name and a password, or neither.

rtsp_trigger.name: Start live RTSP video
rtsp_trigger.description: Put the RTSP stream on live video for a while. Needs RTSP set to 'only when triggered'.

device_id.description: The dashcams to start; all of them if left empty.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long; the alert duration from Configure if left empty.

rtsp_stop.name: Stop live RTSP video
rtsp_stop.description: End every trigger now and go back to the standby picture.

device_id.name: Dashcam
device_id.description: The dashcams to stop; all of them if left empty.
